prompt.initial:
Use case: illustration-story.
Create ONE finished Japanese basketball editorial thumbnail, landscape 16:9, requested size 1536x864 or larger. Opaque PNG.
Design follows the approved black/lime hand-ink sports illustration look: charcoal black #151A18, electric lime #CCF43B, warm ivory, an orange basketball, expressive dry brush diagonal slashes and sparse ink hatching. Sharp readable bold Japanese display typography, few elements, strong hierarchy, clear negative space. Do not copy any player name, old date, score, or statistics from the style reference.
Layout: roughly left 56 percent for large typography; right 44 percent for one large real basketball player in active three-quarter view. All text sits on calm dark fields. No split panels. The figure must not overlap the copy. Keep all text, entire head, both hands and the basketball well inside the frame with safe margins. Lower legs may be cropped naturally below mid-thigh.
Subject is the REAL player Sam Timmins (サム・ティミンズ), randomly chosen from the fixed article's named players. His official B.LEAGUE 2026-27 profile photograph was visually examined at https://www.bleague.jp/files/user/roster/748/2026-27/46904_03.png (profile https://www.bleague.jp/roster_detail/?PlayerID=46904). Render him as a clearly hand-drawn editorial illustration, never a photograph or generic fictional athlete. Faithful visible features: very tall, broad-shouldered sturdy athletic build; light skin; short dark-brown hair with a dense curly/wavy top and short sides; strong thick dark eyebrows; pale blue-gray eyes; elongated broad face with squared jaw, straight prominent nose and short brown moustache and beard/stubble following the mouth, chin and jaw. Use a focused natural expression, keeping features visible in the ink rendering. The beard is short, not a long beard. No headband.
Action: a powerful low post pivot, torso twisting toward the left, knees flexed, BOTH hands securely holding the orange ball at lower chest/waist height on his right side, looking up for a pass. Dynamic motion through shoulders and fabric, not a static portrait. Anatomically coherent two arms, two hands, five fingers where visible, correct joint connections; ball does not obscure face. Plain black basketball jersey with narrow muted magenta piping and plain shorts, absolutely no logos, sponsor text, team wordmarks or jersey numbers. This is an imagined basketball action illustration, not a reconstruction or claim of a specific real game play.
Text: render ONLY these exact strings, with no additional words or numeric claims:
Top left small: 「バスケまとめ」
Date large in lime: 「10/30」
Main headline very large ivory: 「試合結果」
Second headline large lime: 「当日のEFF」
Supporting line medium ivory: 「ポジション別TOP3」
Qualification small but readable on one line below headline: 「B.ONE：公式ポジション確認待ち」
Next small line: 「10/31 08:23取得時点」
Bottom footer clearly readable: 「イラスト（AI生成）」 followed by 「イメージ」
Japanese quote brackets are delimiters, do not print them.
These words summarize the fixed article only: 2026-10-30 results and that day's position-based EFF rankings; B.ONE official positions remain unconfirmed. Do not imply all leagues have a complete ranking. Do not print the random player's name, individual performance, scores, appearance claims, awards or team name. No 22, 14, 35 or rank badges on the player. No team logo, league logo, copied official photo, photographic textures, watermark, extra people, championship or decisive-shot implication. Balance type and energetic illustration so it reads at thumbnail size.
prompt.correction:
Edit the first image, the finished basketball thumbnail. The second image is ONLY the official face/appearance reference for the same real athlete, Sam Timmins; do not paste or reproduce that photograph. Make one focused correction: improve the illustration's framing so the entire hair/head, both hands, every fingertip and the complete basketball have at least 45 pixels of safe margin from all canvas edges. Reduce the illustrated figure by about 8-10 percent while keeping him on the right and keeping the ball to his right; natural cropping of legs below mid-thigh is fine. Keep the face recognizably Sam Timmins with short curly dark-brown top, short sides, prominent eyebrows and nose, light eyes, a broad angular face and short brown stubble/moustache, consistent with reference 2. Do not make the beard longer or the face generic. Preserve the powerful two-handed ball-holding pivot and anatomically clear hands, the plain black jersey with muted magenta piping, no jersey numbers or logos. Preserve the black/lime ink-and-brush illustration style, orange ball, and all existing typography and copy unchanged. Do not shrink the copy.
The exact text remains: バスケまとめ / 10/30 / 試合結果 / 当日のEFF / ポジション別TOP3 / B.ONE：公式ポジション確認待ち / 10/31 08:23取得時点 / イラスト（AI生成） / イメージ.
Keep all text readable and inside the canvas. No player name, player statistics, team or league logos, sponsor text, official photograph, additional people, realistic game recreation or photo-like rendering. Output just ONE finished 16:9 PNG thumbnail at least 1536 pixels wide.
prompt.correction_reason: 初稿の右手指とボールが右端に近かったため、人物を縮小して余白を確保。
prompt.final_visual_review: 最終画像を実見。頭・両手指・ボールの見切れなし。前景の手の親指と4本の指、後方の手の自然な遮蔽を確認。文字・日付・B.ONE留保・取得時点・AI注記が読める。
